select sum(roomSum) roomSum, sum(roomEnd) roomEnd, sum(roomIng) roomIng, sum(roomUnstart) roomUnstart, sum(visitorSum) visitorSum, sum(visitorEnd) visitorEnd, sum(visitorToday) visitorToday, sum(suggestSum) suggestSum, sum(repairSum) repairSum from( select count(*) roomSum,0 roomEnd,0 roomIng,0 roomUnstart,0 visitorSum,0 visitorEnd,0 visitorToday,0 suggestSum,0 repairSum from daily_room_order where start_time>=#{params.start} and end_time<=#{params.end} union select 0,count(*) roomEnd,0,0,0,0,0,0,0 from daily_room_order where start_time>=#{params.start} and end_time<now() union select 0,0,count(*) roomIng,0,0,0,0,0,0 from daily_room_order where start_time<=now() and end_time>=now() union select 0,0,0,count(*) roomUnstart,0,0,0,0,0 from daily_room_order where start_time>=#{params.start} and start_time>now() union
select 0,0,0,0,count(*) visitorSum,0,0,0,0 from door_visitor_ask where create_time>=#{params.start} and create_time<=#{params.end} union select 0,0,0,0,0,count(*) visitorEnd,0,0,0 from door_visitor_ask where create_time>=#{params.start} and create_time<=concat(date_format(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d'),' 00:00:00') union select 0,0,0,0,0,0,count(*) visitorToday,0,0 from door_visitor_ask where TO_DAYS(create_time) = TO_DAYS(NOW()) union
select 0,0,0,0,0,0,0,count(*) suggestSum,0 from daily_suggestion where create_time>=#{params.start} and create_time<=#{params.end} union
select 0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,count(*) repairSum from daily_repair where create_time>=#{params.start} and create_time<=#{params.end} )t
select date_format(create_time,'%m') month, count(*) cnum from door_visitor_ask where year(create_time)=year(NOW()) group by date_format(create_time,'%m')

select a.allday day,case when b.cnum is null then 0 else b.cnum end cnum from ( select date_format(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL config_id-1 DAY),'%m-%d') allday from sys_config order by config_id asc limit 15 )a left join( select date_format(create_time,'%m-%d') day, count(*) cnum from door_visitor_ask where create_time>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 15 DAY) and create_time<=now() group by date_format(create_time,'%m-%d') )b on a.allday=b.day order by a.allday asc
select dva_name,create_time from door_visitor_ask order by create_time desc limit 7
select date_format(create_time,'%m') month, count(*) cnum from daily_room_order where year(create_time)=year(NOW()) group by date_format(create_time,'%m')

select a.allday day,case when b.cnum is null then 0 else b.cnum end cnum from ( select date_format(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL config_id-1 DAY),'%m-%d') allday from sys_config order by config_id asc limit 15 )a left join( select date_format(create_time,'%m-%d') day, count(*) cnum from daily_room_order where create_time>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 15 DAY) and create_time<=now() group by date_format(create_time,'%m-%d') )b on a.allday=b.day order by a.allday asc
select dr.room_name,dro.start_time,dro.end_time from daily_room_order dro left join daily_room dr on dro.room_id=dr.room_id order by create_time desc limit 7
